rules.name: Perishable Allocation Priority
rules.statement: The system must prioritize allocation of perishable items to new Order Requests based on their proximity to the expiration date.
rules.condition: When allocating inventory for an Order Request containing fresh perishables
exceptions: Items flagged as expired are excluded from allocation
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the allocation request and flags the inventory management process for review
rules.rationale: Prioritizing near-expiry items reduces waste and ensures fresh goods reach customers first

parameters.name: expiry_proximity_threshold
parameters.description: The time window defining 'proximity to expiration' for prioritization

rules.name: Expired Item Order Rejection
rules.statement: An Order Request must not be successfully created if it contains any item where the current date is later than the item's defined expiry date.
rules.condition: During the Order Request creation or validation phase
exceptions: None
rules.if_violated: The system automatically rejects the Order Request and notifies the customer that the item is unavailable
rules.rationale: Preventing the sale of expired goods protects customer health and maintains brand reputation

parameters.name: expiry_date_field
parameters.description: The specific date field defining the item's shelf life limit

rules.name: Stock Lock Release Timeout
rules.statement: Locked stock must be automatically released if the Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window.
rules.condition: When an Order Request remains in a 'pending confirmation' state
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner for specific high-value orders
rules.if_violated: The system releases the stock back to general availability, potentially causing overselling if not monitored
rules.rationale: Prevents inventory hoarding and ensures stock availability for other customers during peak demand

parameters.name: confirmation_timeout_duration
parameters.description: The maximum time allowed for order confirmation before stock release

rules.name: Sync Discrepancy Flagging
rules.statement: The system must flag a synchronization discrepancy if the data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or if a sync failure is detected.
exceptions: Scheduled maintenance windows where sync is paused
rules.if_violated: The system halts order processing for affected stores and alerts the operations team
rules.rationale: Ensures inventory data integrity to prevent overselling and allocation errors

parameters.name: latency_threshold_seconds
parameters.description: The maximum acceptable delay for data synchronization

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Consistency
rules.statement: The system must not assign an order to a Store Partner if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot indicates insufficient quantity for any item in the request.
rules.condition: During order allocation when a customer submits a request with multiple items
exceptions: Items marked as 'Back in Stock' with a confirmed ETA within the delivery window
rules.if_violated: The order remains unassigned and is flagged for manual review to prevent overselling and customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling which leads to order cancellations, financial loss, and eroded customer trust

parameters.name: minimum_available_quantity
parameters.description: The quantity required for each item in the order

rules.name: Delivery Proof Integrity
rules.statement: Funds must not be released to the Store Partner until a valid delivery proof containing a timestamp and signature is recorded in the system.
rules.condition: At the moment of Financial Settlement Handover confirmation
exceptions: Customer explicitly waives proof requirement via verified settings
Dispute resolution overrides automatic hold
rules.if_violated: The transaction is automatically reversed and funds are held in escrow pending manual verification
rules.rationale: Ensures the platform only pays for successfully delivered goods, mitigating fraud and operational risk

parameters.name: required_proof_elements
parameters.description: List of mandatory fields like timestamp and signature

rules.name: Regulatory License Validity
rules.statement: The system must block order allocation to a Store Partner if their primary operating license is flagged as invalid or expired.
rules.condition: During order allocation and at the start of each business day
exceptions: Temporary suspension due to administrative review with an approved override code
rules.if_violated: The Store Partner is immediately suspended from receiving orders until compliance is restored
rules.rationale: Maintains legal compliance and protects the platform from liability associated with unlicensed operations

parameters.name: license_expiry_threshold
parameters.description: Days before expiry to trigger a warning

rules.name: External Proof Verification Standard
rules.statement: Delivery proof retrieved via external API must be treated with the same verification standards as locally captured proof.
rules.condition: When validating delivery proof regardless of source
exceptions: API returns a specific 'pending verification' status defined in the integration contract
rules.if_violated: The delivery proof is rejected and the order status remains 'In Transit' or 'Pending Proof'
rules.rationale: Ensures data integrity and prevents fraud by standardizing verification logic across all data sources

parameters.name: verification_algorithm_id
parameters.description: Identifier for the standard verification logic applied

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Locking
rules.statement: The system must deduct reserved quantities from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot immediately upon order assignment to prevent overselling.
rules.condition: When an order is automatically assigned to a store partner
exceptions: System outage preventing database write
rules.if_violated: The business risks selling items that are not in stock, leading to order cancellations and customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling in a high-volume, low-latency environment

parameters.name: reservation_timeout
parameters.description: Duration the inventory is held before release if order fails

rules.name: Dynamic Route Recalculation
rules.statement: The system must recalculate estimated arrival times and delivery paths if live traffic patterns change significantly after initial assignment.
rules.condition: When live traffic data indicates a significant deviation from the initial route estimate
exceptions: Traffic change is within acceptable variance threshold
rules.if_violated: Delivery times exceed the 60-minute target, risking service failure and penalties
rules.rationale: Ensures the ultra-fast delivery promise is met despite real-world conditions

parameters.name: traffic_variance_threshold
parameters.description: Percentage deviation in traffic speed triggering a recalculation

rules.name: Agent Capacity Enforcement
rules.statement: The system must not assign a new delivery slot to an agent if their current workload exceeds the maximum capacity defined for their service zone.
rules.condition: When the Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign a new order to a gig worker
exceptions: Emergency override by Platform Operator with documented reason
rules.if_violated: Agent becomes overloaded, leading to delayed deliveries and potential order abandonment
rules.rationale: Maintains service quality and agent performance by preventing overloading

parameters.name: max_zone_capacity
parameters.description: Maximum number of concurrent deliveries allowed per service zone

rules.name: Service Area Boundary Compliance
rules.statement: Orders originating from addresses outside the active Service Area Definition must be rejected by the Order Allocation Engine.
rules.condition: When an incoming order request is received for delivery
exceptions: Manual override for VIP customers or special promotions
rules.if_violated: The business incurs costs for deliveries outside its operational scope and risks regulatory non-compliance
rules.rationale: Ensures operations remain within defined, optimized geographic boundaries

parameters.name: active_service_area_version
parameters.description: Identifier for the current valid geospatial definition

rules.name: Target Timeframe Adherence
rules.statement: The system must classify an order as fulfilled only if the total elapsed time from Order Request creation to Delivery Proof confirmation does not exceed the committed target window.
rules.condition: When an order reaches the Delivery Proof confirmation stage
exceptions: Force majeure events declared by the Regulatory Authority
Customer-initiated order cancellation prior to handover
rules.if_violated: The order is flagged as 'Late' and triggers a service credit workflow for the Customer and a penalty assessment for the Delivery Partner
rules.rationale: This ensures the core value proposition of ultra-fast delivery is maintained and SLAs are met

parameters.name: committed_target_window
parameters.description: The maximum allowed duration in minutes for order fulfillment

rules.name: Service Area Activation Prerequisite
rules.statement: The system must prevent the creation of a new Order Request if the associated Service Area Definition is not in an active state.
rules.condition: When a customer or partner initiates an Order Request
exceptions: Emergency override protocols authorized by the Platform Operator
System maintenance windows explicitly approved by the Regulatory Authority
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected immediately and the user is notified that the service zone is unavailable
rules.rationale: This prevents orders from being accepted in zones where logistics or regulatory compliance are not verified

parameters.name: active_state
parameters.description: The status indicating the Service Area Definition is operational

rules.name: Delivery Partner Performance Threshold
rules.statement: The system must suspend a Delivery Partner's ability to accept new assignments if their on-time delivery rate falls below the minimum acceptable threshold within a rolling evaluation period.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Partner completes a batch of deliveries
exceptions: Temporary suspension due to verified force majeure events
New partner probationary period grace window defined in contract
rules.if_violated: The Delivery Partner is automatically removed from the active pool and must undergo a re-qualification audit
rules.rationale: This maintains service quality standards and protects the brand reputation for speed

parameters.name: minimum_acceptable_threshold
parameters.description: The minimum percentage of on-time deliveries required to remain active

parameters.name: rolling_evaluation_period
parameters.description: The time window used to calculate the delivery performance rate

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Consistency
rules.statement: The system must invalidate an Order Request if the real-time inventory snapshot indicates that any selected item is unavailable at the assigned Store Partner.
rules.condition: When an Order Request is submitted for processing
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner manager for high-priority customer orders
System latency tolerance window defined in the SLA agreement
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected to prevent overselling and subsequent refund disputes
rules.rationale: This ensures accurate inventory synchronization and prevents fulfillment failures due to stock discrepancies

parameters.name: real_time_inventory_snapshot
parameters.description: The current stock level data for all items in the order
